**Observation Log:**

[EVENT] User is planning a trip to Seattle.

[PREFERENCE] User needs help finding a hotel with a great view of the city.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Edgewater Hotel offers breathtaking views of Puget Sound, the Olympic Mountains, and the Seattle skyline, with many rooms having private balconies.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Four Seasons Hotel Seattle features rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows offering stunning views of the city, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Alexis Hotel has rooms with views of the city skyline, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains, with some rooms having a view of the Space Needle.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Hyatt at Olive 8 is an eco-friendly hotel located in downtown Seattle, offering rooms with views of the city skyline, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Pan Pacific Seattle is situated in the Belltown neighborhood and offers rooms with views of the Space Needle, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] W Seattle features rooms with views of the city skyline, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Sheraton Seattle Hotel has rooms with views of the city skyline, Puget Sound, and the Olympic Mountains, located near Pike Place Market.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] User should request a room with a view when booking, as not all rooms may have the same vistas.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] User can search for "rooms with a view" or "waterfront rooms" on hotel websites or booking sites like Expedia or Booking.com.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Hotels with rooftop bars or lounges include The Roof at The Edgewater Hotel, The Nest at The Hotel Theodore, The Roof Garden at The Sheraton Seattle Hotel, and The View Lounge at The Pan Pacific Seattle.

[PREFERENCE] User likes hotels with unique features, such as a rooftop pool or a hot tub on the balcony.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Hyatt at Olive 8 has a rooftop pool and hot tub with views of the city skyline and Puget Sound.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] W Seattle has a rooftop pool called WET, which is a popular spot for relaxation and city views.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Sheraton Seattle Hotel has a rooftop pool and hot tub with views of the city and Puget Sound.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Edgewater Hotel has luxury rooms and suites with private balconies featuring hot tubs, perfect for views of Puget Sound and the Olympic Mountains.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Four Seasons Hotel Seattle has rooms and suites with private balconies that include hot tubs, offering views of the city and Puget Sound.
